role: One textured cuboid of a model: eight PositionTextureVertex corners, six TexturedQuad faces with the standard unwrapped UV layout, and the mirror handling ModelRenderer.mirror needs.
scope_reason: Every rendered box in the native engine (mobs, the first-person arm, the chest item model) is this object's math.

members.name: vertexPositions
members.note: the 8 corners are transformed and projected per face instead of stored

members.name: quadList
members.note: the six faces are emitted directly; the comment at raster_mobs.c:789 names ModelBox's six quads

members.name: posX1
members.note: the corner coordinates live in the mob_box struct (x,y,z,dx,dy,dz,grow)

members.name: ModelBox
members.note: the grow inflate, the UV rectangles of the six quads, and the mirror swap (raster_mobs.c:828-833: x corners swapped, v flipped on the affected face)

members.name: render
members.note: raster_hand.c:151 documents the same six-quad draw as ModelBox.render as a compiled display list

notes: The mirror behavior was the subtle part: the native comment (raster_mobs.c:828-833) records that the mirror swaps the x corners but keeps each corner's own v, flipping v inside the face.
